paragraphs.text: The Lord, lit by Himself, shines through the Lady as the whole world from Shiva down to clay. That shining is two things at once: it is how He makes the world, and it is also the worlds being alive. So what does made mean here? It means depending on His shining — nothing more. And nothing can cover Him up: veiling is impossible.
